El Camote
natural

Ez a panorámás kilátó széles rálátást nyújt a Robinson Crusoe-sziget zord tájára.
Acest punct de belvedere panoramic oferă priveliști ample asupra peisajului accidentat al Insulei Robinson Crusoe.
This panoramic viewpoint offers sweeping vistas over the rugged landscape of Robinson Crusoe Island.
Plazoleta El Yunque
natural

Ez a festői kilátóhely közvetlen rálátást biztosít a sziget impozáns El Yunque csúcsára.
Această zonă pitorească de belvedere oferă o perspectivă directă către impunătorul vârf El Yunque al insulei.
This scenic viewing area provides a direct line of sight towards the island's imposing El Yunque peak.
Cerro El Yunque
natural
Dieser Berg erhebt sich über die Robinson-Crusoe-Insel und ist der höchste Gipfel des Archipels.
A Robinson Crusoe-sziget fölé magasodó hegy a szigetcsoport legmagasabb csúcsa.

Rising above Robinson Crusoe Island, this mountain serves as the highest peak in the archipelago.
Mirador de Selkirk
natural

A magas gerincen található híres kilátóhelyről kémlelte a Csendes-óceán horizontját a hajótörött Alexander Selkirk.

Situated on a high ridge, this famous lookout is where the marooned sailor Alexander Selkirk scanned the Pacific horizon for passing ships.

natural

landmark

This coastal cave provides a natural shelter near the rocky shores where local sea lions typically gather.
Lobería Pangal
landmark

natural

This protected marine reserve safeguards the rich underwater biodiversity and unique endemic species of the island's coastal waters.
